headline_pain: What If Rates Drop After You Buy?
headline_outcome: You Win Either Way. Here's How.
primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." What if rates drop after you've locked in your purchase price? You get a lower rate AND the price you secured today. That's the off-the-plan advantage. Deposit now, settle when the build completes. If rates fall, your repayments shrink. If prices rise, your asset grows. New purpose-built warehouses in Truganina for owner-occupiers. 20km from Melbourne CBD near Princes Freeway. The question isn't whether rates will move — it's whether you'll have locked in your price when they do.
description: Off-the-plan timing means you could benefit from future rate drops
